card.name: Ends of female first names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a female first name that is split into parts, such as -a, -ana, -ina or -eta. It appears in author or scientist credits just before a surname.

modes.label: Name ending before surname
modes.description: A short ending piece completes a female first name, and a surname follows next.

modes.label: Longer name ending
modes.description: Endings like -ana, -ina or -iana finish a longer first name in a citation or byline.
